_note: House wording per letter type. Tokens: {name} {department} {departmentShort} {position} {title} {session} {date} {effective} {closingLine}. {title} is "Technical Lead" for department roles and "President" for board roles. "@role" pulls listIntro / bullets for the record's position from roles.json. Inline <strong> allowed.

appointment.label: Appointment
heading: Letter of
Appointment
paragraphs: The Software Development Club, VIT Bhopal University, is pleased to appoint you as {title} for the {sessionLower}. The appointment takes effect from the date of this letter and continues until the close of the session.
closing: {closingLine} Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing.

promotion.label: Promotion
heading: Letter of
Promotion
paragraphs: On the recommendation of the leadership, the Software Development Club is pleased to promote you to {title} with effect from the date of this letter, in recognition of your work over the preceding term.
closing: All other terms of your appointment continue unchanged. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing.

termination.label: Termination
heading: Letter of
Termination
paragraphs: Following review by the leadership, the Software Development Club has decided to terminate your appointment as {title} with effect from {effective}. The matter was put to you and your response considered.
termination.listIntro: The following applies from the effective date:
bullets: You cease to hold office and to represent the club in any capacity.
Club accounts, files, assets and credentials are to be handed over within seven days.
Work completed before this date remains credited to you in the club's record.
You may appeal in writing to the faculty coordinator within seven days.
closing: Your membership of the university community is unaffected by this letter. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing.

tenure.label: Tenure Completion
heading: Letter of
Tenure Completion
paragraphs: As your tenure as {title} of the Software Development Club, VIT Bhopal University, comes to a close, the club records its sincere gratitude for your dedication, leadership and contribution throughout the {session}.

Under your stewardship the club has grown as a space for innovation, learning and collaboration. Your initiatives set new benchmarks, your mentorship helped members step up, and your pursuit of excellence leaves a legacy for the incoming leadership.
closing: Though your role concludes, your contribution remains part of the club's foundation. We wish you continued success in all your future endeavours.
